about: Gretex Industries Limited is a Kolkata-based wholesale/retail distributor of musical instruments, professional audio/AV equipment and accessories, with 23+ brand partnerships, 5,500+ products and multi-channel sales through retail, dealers, institutions/B2B and online. [1]
